table.Value: Greedy assigns each hex to its nearest open store with capacity left (nearest-first walk), which decides new against cannibalised demand. CP-SAT maximises orders only: a hex no capacity-bound store takes goes to its nearest open store, but among capacity-bound stores serving the same orders the solver's assignment stands, so its fresh/cannibalised split can differ from greedy's. Fresh and cannibalised are judged against the existing stores' nearest-first walk, for every method
table.Source: No external source

table.Value: Shares and capacity in hundredths of an order (round(orders × 100)), because CP-SAT needs integers. CP-SAT's objective and bound use these rounded shares; the plan's metrics use the unrounded ones, so they can differ from the objective by rounding
